sam: CTA recommended: "Request a Dedicated Eval" (field) and "Start a Trial" (self-serve).
erin: Webinar scheduled 2026-06-15 10:00 PT. Registration: https://events.redwood/deploy-modes.
aj: I'll have drafts uploaded by 09:30 PT tomorrow. Please react with :thumbsup: when copy is in.
